name: OB1 / OF1 entry confirmation experiments
activation: experiment_arms.activated_at, recorded at first engine start with the dedicated switch on
candidate_universe: Current enabled OB1/OF1 intraday 15m paper-stage routed candidates, after router session/geometry/cost checks; observed before research slot/cooldown/contract-build checks. Not all raw detector signals.

OB1C.rule: First-touch control; no additional rejection filter

OB1J.rule: Same retest candle must close strictly above block top for bullish, strictly below block bottom for bearish; equality fails

OF1C.rule: Aligned OF1 control; cohort separate from old OF1R records

OF1G.rule: At least one of DELTA/IMBALANCE and one of ABSORPTION/directional POC movement/ACCEPTANCE; groups remain correlated

execution: One shared option build per source candidate for eligible arms; same entry, contract, one-lot quantity, costs, target, stop, trailing and trigger-family exit rules. Independent slots and cooldowns. No broker orders.
entry_timing: Same closed decision bar only. No wait for subsequent confirmation bars. Record observed entry timestamp minus decision candle close; no hypothetical delayed fill.

ledgers.official: Mid entry; production target/exit policy; estimated round-trip costs deducted
ledgers.simulated: Fresh executable ask/bid and depth required, fees deducted, unresolved and unavailable fills excluded from closed return averages

primary_comparison: Closed net R, trade count and realised closed-trade drawdown; show both ledgers separately. Also match filtered candidates to control outcomes: missed winners, avoided losers, pending, no control position.
coverage: Report all observed candidates, filter pass/fail, missing evidence, positions and missing outcome coverage. OF1 breakdown by evidence combination. Old versions excluded, preserved in storage.
rollback: ENTRY_CONFIRMATION_EXPERIMENTS=off stops only new experiment entries/observations; open research positions still exit. Drain both ledgers before reverting to a binary without the four new arm readers.
